title: Ollama Disabled Claude Code's Token Countdown
caption:
I'd have blamed the model for this one.

Claude Code was putting a live "tokens left" countdown into the system message. Ollama's v0.33.0 notes say Ollama moved it to the front of the prompt and it broke the KV cache on every request. So they disabled it.

Prompt caching only reuses a byte-identical prefix. Anything that ticks up there costs you everything behind it.

What's at the top of yours?

slides.headline:

slides.sub: Claude Code's "tokens left" countdown landed at the front of the prompt and broke the KV cache on every request. Ollama v0.33.0, Aug 21.

slides.title: Prefix or nothing
slides.sub: Cache hits need 100% identical prompt segments. A change to system invalidates system and every message behind it.

slides.headline:
46,000 of 47,000
tokens.
Reprocessed.
slides.sub: Same release: a resumed prefill logged restore points it couldn't cover. On recurrent-layer models, a near-perfect match started from zero.
